understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spikes.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is grid-based with directional actions. Gravity is currently DOWN and affects the player’s position; movement can be blocked or have no effect. Each level provides two attempts of up to 50 turns. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. The available context did not demonstrate clicks or undo, so their exact behavior is unknown.
